title: Ben Dinai

paragraphs: Mentioned in Kelim chapter 5, mishnah 10: "And this is the oven of Ben Dinai." Rabbi Ovadia of Bartenura commented: "My teachers explained that it is the name of a person who made ovens, but I heard that it is so called because they ruled many rulings concerning it." There is also an Elazar ben Dinai who was a murderer; see his entry.
